remarks: Asking for H/B- 5 pm Wednesday 10/9. Welcome to 17 Ambler Drive! This charming house is a great opportunity for anyone looking for a comfortable and well-kept home in a great neighborhood. This property features an entry/mudroom, living room, dining room with built-in shelving. Kitchen with SS appliances, rear family room flooded with sunlight and access to a HUGE deck over looking a large flat private backyard. Full bathroom and 1st of 3 bedrooms (currently used as an office) finishes the main level. Upstairs boasts 2 large bedrooms with ample closet space and a full hall bath. This property is located in a quiet yet convenient neighborhood with proximity to Westport Ave. Full Unfinished basement with laundry, fully fenced in back yard, new hot water heater, newer luxury vinyl flooring, French drain and foundation sealant, 3 yr roof.
